description: Discover and call live DingTalk tools through an official DingTalk MCP marketplace service, such as DingTalk Docs, Calendar, or Contacts.

fields.label: MCP URL
fields.description: The secret Streamable HTTP URL of one DingTalk MCP marketplace service. Open a service on the DingTalk MCP marketplace (https://aihub.dingtalk.com/#/mcp-market/mcp, DingTalk login required), click 获取 MCP Server 配置 (Get MCP Server config), and copy the URL. Each connection exposes one marketplace service. Official guide: https://open.dingtalk.com/document/development/mcp-square-introduction.

actions.name: call_tool
actions.description: Call a current DingTalk MCP tool with JSON arguments. Discover the tool first and confirm the user's intent because the endpoint may expose actions that send, overwrite, cancel, or delete DingTalk data.

toolName.description: The exact tool name returned by list_tools.

arguments.description: JSON arguments matching the inputSchema returned for the selected tool.

inputSchema.description: Input for invoking one current DingTalk MCP tool.

result.description: The tool result. Structured MCP content is returned directly; otherwise the MCP content envelope is preserved.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by the DingTalk MCP tool.

actions.name: list_tools
actions.description: Discover the current tools, behavior annotations, and live input schemas exposed by this DingTalk MCP connection.

name.description: The exact DingTalk MCP tool name to pass to call_tool.

description.description: The current tool description supplied by DingTalk MCP.

title.description: A human-readable title for the tool.

readOnlyHint.description: Whether the tool is expected not to modify DingTalk data.

destructiveHint.description: Whether the tool may perform a destructive DingTalk operation.

idempotentHint.description: Whether repeating the same call is expected to have no additional effect.

openWorldHint.description: Whether the tool may interact with entities outside DingTalk.

annotations.description: MCP behavior hints supplied by the connected DingTalk server.

inputSchema.description: The current JSON Schema for the tool arguments, supplied by DingTalk MCP.

items.description: A tool currently exposed by the connected DingTalk MCP endpoint.

tools.description: Tools currently exposed by this DingTalk MCP connection.

outputSchema.description: The current DingTalk MCP tool catalog.
